documented_probe: C-92072676 (connect to a postgres service using compose-provided credentials): the covering task derives host/port/db/user/password from a compose-style file and establishes a live connection; wrong credentials or the wrong published port make the store unreachable and the report empty. Verifier executes the deliverable on hidden compose/database pairs with different credentials, ports and quoting.
notes: Medium: two-stage (parse compose -> live connect -> structured export). The visible instance uses a non-default published port (5433) and scram auth, so a wrong password genuinely fails to connect. Hidden cases vary database name, user, password, quoting and row population (empty, single, duplicate/fractional rows). Small rubric nonzero for the parse->connect->export dependency chain, psql tooling, live-service statefulness, hidden generalization, and quantitative exactness of the JSON report.
